name: harold-skills
description: Harold's personal collection of Claude Code skills, organized as plugins.

plugins.name: clinical-research
plugins.description: Clinical research workflow skills: study design, variable coding, statistical analysis, and paper drafting. For clinical medicine researchers conducting retrospective cohort studies.

plugins.name: excalidrawer
plugins.description: Code-first Excalidraw diagram generation. Per-type skills (flowchart / timeline / architecture / sequence) on a shared base clarify intent via AskUserQuestion, compose sugar elements, and call the excalidrawer MCP server to produce .excalidraw / .svg / .png outputs. Single-sourced from guohaonan-shy/excalidrawer; installing auto-registers the MCP server.

plugins.name: memex
plugins.description: Personal memory wiki built from your conversations. Pluggable connectors (lark / 飞书 today; wechat / slack later) pull raw chats + meeting transcripts, render them losslessly to markdown, then distill them into an obsidian-style wiki of people and things — persons / groups / topics (events live inline and in a dated log digest), written with #tag + Dataview fields + [[wikilinks]] + provenance anchors. Verb-oriented skills: ingest (fetch+render), recap (distill), comm-memory (dictation CRUD + lint), recall (fuzzy-query read front-door), reply-coach (draft high-friction replies). User data lives under ~/.memex/ — plugin dir is read-only references and prompts.

plugins.name: content-creator
plugins.description: Content creation toolkit for short-video / social-feed creators (Xiaohongshu, 视频号, YouTube). Currently ships thumbnail-gen — interactive HTML/CSS thumbnail generator with portrait-photo layout math, multi-platform spec presets (3:4 / 4:3 / 9:16 / 16:9), multi-ratio derivation, and Playwright screenshot rendering. Bundled Smiley Sans (得意黑) font. Roadmap: title-writer / post-writer / tag-gen / video-script.

plugins.name: happy-life
plugins.description: Personal lifestyle skills for small daily rituals, taste memory, and playful self-care workflows. Currently ships daily-coffee-oracle — a Markdown-profile based coffee recommendation skill that learns from casual coffee chat and generates refined ASCII coffee cards.

plugins.name: idea-loop
plugins.description: Closed loop from idea to shipped engineering, backed by a docs/ Obsidian vault as its knowledge base. Nine skills, no state machine — grill, uiux-imagine, uiux-refine and dreaming stay human-invoked (an interview, two design stages whose every exit stops on a person, and destructive disposals); the other five can also be started by a caller, so a ticket can be executed and taken to a reviewed PR without a human in the middle. No state machine either — a file's existence IS its status: a spec exists while the work is in flight, and is deleted once an ADR records why/how/result. grill runs a design-tree interview in frontier rounds (facts are the agent's job, decisions are the human's) until nothing is silently assumed, and when a product decision cannot be settled in prose it calls prototype in-session; prototype is throwaway code answering ONE question — a clickable single-file state model, or structurally distinct gray-box variants — whose artifact and verdict both land in the raw bucket; to-spec lands that conversation as a raw transcript plus one spec (problem, user stories, implementation + testing decisions, agreed seams); uiux-imagine is the divergent design half, human-invoked, and runs only while the spec sits at 等设计冻结 — it opens just the altitude still undecided (language / structure / layout / component), renders variants at the lowest fidelity that tells them apart, takes only directional notes, runs no critic, and ships exactly ONE artifact: a seven-section direction note written back into the spec, its shape checked by scripts/direction-note-check.mjs; the two uiux-* stages are a bracketed, conditional segment of the forward loop (grill → to-spec → [uiux-imagine → uiux-refine] → to-ticket → implement → pr-*): you walk them only when to-spec landed the spec at 等设计冻结, and a spec that landed at 在飞 goes straight from to-spec to to-ticket. uiux-refine is the convergent half, also human-invoked and wanting a fresh window — it rebuilds the canvas in design-preview/ from that note alone (never from imagine's renders), converges it in a two-model loop where a fresh-context critic returns findings plus a score that scripts/critic-score.mjs audits against its own findings, routes each finding by kind (direction stops for the human, pattern earns reference research, craft is fixed in place), then runs a subtraction pass and an AI-tells pass, and on the human's signature freezes the canvas, per-cell screenshots and ledger into the raw bucket, replaces the spec's direction note with a freeze summary and flips it to 在飞; to-ticket slices a spec into tracer-bullet vertical cuts with blocking edges, each a temporary credential deleted on merge, and holds the design-freeze gate for UI work; implement turns one ticket into one commit in a context holding nothing but that ticket, driving TDD at the seams the spec already agreed, never reopening the plan, and stopping to report rather than guessing when a precondition does not hold — on a UI ticket it runs the measurement/pixel comparators so visual correctness is a test that can go red — then hands off to pr-review, which opens or reuses the PR and runs up to two automatic rounds: Codex (gpt-6-sol) reviews Correctness / Standards / Spec in parallel, Claude Sonnet 5 reproduces each candidate and decides at the merge-base whether this PR introduced it, fixes what it introduced with a regression test, backlogs what it did not, has a separate agent verify each fix red to green, and publishes one GitHub post per round whose finding shape the helper enforces — stopping at mergeReady and waiting for a human merge order; dreaming reconciles every doc against origin/main — including CLAUDE.md — and proposes disposals the human approves before anything moves. The design side lives here too, not as a separate plugin: the taste and craft references under references/design/ (core law, DESIGN.md format, surface/module/component altitude protocols, the static-UI and motion protocols), a deterministic design-lint hook that fires on writes to design-preview/ and design-motion-preview/ HTML, and a headless Playwright MCP server. prototype, uiux-imagine and uiux-refine are pinned to a baseline eval under evals/ — one real case carrying a minimal DESIGN.md + PRODUCT.md, run once and archived, re-run on every change to a rubric, a prompt or a SKILL.md, with the whole loop's wiring check riding along as its assertions rather than as a one-off dry run; this is a deliberate exception to the repo-wide "subjective output skips quantitative eval" convention, stated as such next to it. Generalized out of a real project (Toeflair) — reads the current repo's own CLAUDE.md and lint/typecheck config rather than hardcoding either. Skills own the mechanics; the human owns every judgement call.

plugins.name: interview-coach
plugins.description: AI Engineer / AI Agent Engineer / Harness 方向的面试陪练。mock-interview 基于简历 + 目标方向扮演面试官,按四类问题框架(概括/选型/实现/延伸场景)深挖简历项目和领域知识点,全程不给反馈；interview-review 消费一场面试的转录(mock-interview 产物,或真实面试的录音转写),逐题做内容结构/表达/hook/技术准确性四维复盘,并把暴露出的知识漏洞讲透。两个 skill 共享同一份从真实面试教练转录里蒸馏出的四类问题框架和领域知识点清单。
